Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **federal public holidays that create long weekends in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you need province‑specific holidays—e.g., Family Day in Alberta, St. Patricks’ Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.—you’ll have to add those separately.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1** | New Year’s Day | Sunday | **Jan 1–3** (Sun–Mon) | Observed on Monday Jan 2 |
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Ontario) | Monday | **Feb 18–20** (Sat–Mon) | Other provinces observe on different dates |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) | Easter Monday is a provincial holiday |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) | |
| **Jul 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) | Observed on Monday Jul 3 |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | **Sep 2–4** (Sat–Mon) | |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | **Oct 7–9** (Sat–Mon) | |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Saturday | **Nov 11–13** (Sat–Mon) | Observed on Monday Nov 13 |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | **Dec 23–25** (Sat–Mon) | |
| **Dec 26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | — | Not a long weekend |

### How to use this in your app

1. **Store the dates** in a simple array or database table.  
2. **Flag the “long‑weekend span”** so you can highlight the entire weekend in your UI.  
3. **Add province‑specific holidays** if you want a full calendar for each region.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full list of provincial holidays for 2023, or if you need help formatting this data for your app!
